Role: Data Scientist NLP (AI) Engineer
Company: Ford Motor Company
Company category: Producto Tech
Location: Mexico City, Mexico / Remote
Work model: Remote
Application language: en
JD fidelity: full (40/100)
JD generation eligible: true

Technologies / capabilities: Python; SQL; NLP; LLMs; Generative AI; Agentic AI; GCP; Vertex AI; BigQuery; Cloud Run; CI/CD; MLOps; LLM evaluation; Responsible AI; Model evaluation; AI applications
Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.; Professional experience in data science, machine learning, applied AI, NLP or a related technical role.; Strong Python and SQL skills with maintainable, testable, production-quality software practices.; Hands-on experience developing applications with commercial or open-source LLMs, prompt engineering, model integration and core NLP concepts.; Experience with GCP data and AI services, particularly Vertex AI and BigQuery, or comparable major-cloud experience with ability to transition to GCP.; Experience with APIs, containers, CI/CD, identity/access management and production monitoring.; Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into measurable technical objectives and deliver iteratively in cross-functional teams.; Preferred experience includes Vertex AI tooling, BigQuery ML/Dataflow, LLM evaluation datasets, red-team tests, LLMOps/MLOps, scalable inference and regulated or safety-conscious environments.
Responsibilities: Design, prototype, evaluate and productionize LLM-powered applications for enterprise and customer-facing use cases.; Develop prompt strategies, structured-output workflows, routing, context-management approaches and model adaptation methods where appropriate.; Create LLM evaluation frameworks spanning task quality, factuality, relevance, robustness, latency, cost, safety and user experience.; Explore agentic AI patterns including planning, tool/function calling, memory, reflection, human approvals and multi-step workflows.; Develop scalable AI/ML solutions on GCP using services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub.; Build reusable Python components, APIs, experimentation pipelines, data products and structured/unstructured data pipelines.; Perform exploratory analysis, feature engineering, statistical modeling and machine learning for broader data science needs.; Implement observability, monitoring, guardrails, automated testing and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.; Communicate technical findings, risks, tradeoffs and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Source fit score: 92/100
Source fit summary: Buena oportunidad para fortalecer el posicionamiento de IA aplicada y GenAI en una empresa global.
Source strengths: Rol remoto para México con foco explícito en NLP, LLMs y aplicaciones de IA.; Incluye colaboración con producto, ingeniería, analytics y negocio.; Encaja con GenAI, evaluación de modelos, responsible AI y traducción de problemas complejos a soluciones aplicadas.
Source gaps: No aprovecha directamente banca, fraude o riesgo.; Puede ser más especializado en NLP/AI engineering que en data science financiero.
